author: codex-ai-validation-partition-audit
scope: Metadata audit only; historical scientific partitions and artifacts are unchanged.

catalog_metadata_snapshot.query: SELECT observation_id,acquisition_key,port_id,sensor,captured_at,status,zone_id,observable_fraction,review_status,json_extract(data_json,'$.scene_complete') AS scene_complete,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revisions r WHERE r.entity_type='observation' AND r.entity_id=observation_id) AS prior_review FROM observations WHERE captured_at>='2025-10-01' AND captured_at<'2026-01-01' AND sensor='sentinel-2' ORDER BY observation_id
catalog_metadata_snapshot.note: No full database hash was taken. Only explicitly projected metadata was read.

current_gate.required_next_action: Adjudicate the six S2 TRAIN first-pass scopes, then run a frozen e099 development probe on those same scopes. Do not open CAL before declaring the result and next gate.
current_gate.s1_blocker: TRAIN has zero adjudicated positive objects for PBR and STC.

e099_probe.interpretation: TRAIN development on target passes unused by e099. Clarity-selected scopes and AI references do not constitute independent final validation. PBR/STC share January 10 and May 18 passes; six areas are four physical passes.

independent_reference.availability_source: Coordinator relayed explicit user confirmation in this session; no external connection was attempted by this audit.
independent_reference.remaining_need: Independent human adjudication or dated external evidence is needed for ambiguous Caribbean docks/small craft and an independent real-world accuracy claim. AIS would need spatial/temporal correspondence and coverage; absence of AIS cannot label a negative.

test.first_slot_day_rule: April 2026 begins on day 2; later test months begin on day 1; subsequent anchors are day 12 and day 22.

unused_gap_windows_not_eligible_under_cu: 2025-07-01..2025-10-01 violates TRAIN-to-CAL 92-day embargo if January-June TRAIN is retained
temporal_protocol.caveat: Acquisition/pass disjointness is verified from metadata. Correlated vessel events and human/external reference independence are not established by metadata.

cal_s2_availability.selection_rule: Conservatively exclude every recorded exposed/activated S2 CAL physical pass globally across ports, every previous S2 CAL primary pass even without exposure receipt, and every UTC calendar day containing such a pass. Preserve original reserve ordering. Include cloudy/unusable dates in the frame; observability is descriptive, never the selection criterion.
cal_s2_availability.current_protocol_limit: Current reserve activation is for access/bands/context/mask/zero reviewable marine area, not adverse model performance. Any new CAL cycle requires its own frozen amendment and representative sampling before labels/predictions; existing failed CAL remains unchanged.

additional_train.source: Read-only projection of original TRAIN primaries and explicitly activated reserves, catalog review identity, and data/review-intake receipt identity; no detector output used.

known_selector_exposure_gap.reason: Unimported RAW first-pass reports are not covered by catalog revisions or first-pass intake receipts. April 3 S1 Caribbean scopes can be re-proposed as fresh by the selector.
known_selector_exposure_gap.conservative_exclusion: Exclude all Caribbean S1 target passes on April 3, April 19, May 1, plus all prior catalog/intake exposures.

additional_train.june18_s1_caribbean: Original selected slice has marine fractions below 0.5; another already materialized slice in the same physical orbit covers more of the ports but is outside the currently activated target list. Do not count it as another visit or silently activate it.

recommendation: Complete the new TRAIN adjudication and e099 probe now. Keep S1 CAL and all TEST data closed. Preserve CAL candidate metadata for a future preregistered cycle; do not imply that unused dates or additional patches provide enough independent reference support.
